fix_tasks.root_cause: In the hold the default LAKE_R12 water drops the rest ring shading (Water.ts: k *= 1 - smoothstep(0,1,uHold) under LK_WAVEB). It switches to the Cycles Wave-modifier crests (lkWaveH: 0.173 m Gaussian crests, 2.717 m apart, 1.115 m/s, front R = mix(8.2, 21.5, uHold)), each found per pixel by the LK_WAVE2 12-step march plus 5 bisections. The train is perfectly concentric and noise-free. The only detail on a flank is the 0.07 m Cycles bump (lkBump, a few degrees of tilt against flank slopes up to ~19 deg), so each long near flank mirrors one smooth patch of sky: one clean frame-wide arc. The tilted reflection magnifies T1's half-resolution mirror target (LakeMirror MIRROR_SCALE T1 [0.5,0.5]) along the flanks, and textureGrad cannot hide magnification, hence the texel stair-steps. Every pixel starts the march at the same height (no dither), so crest-top rows step together and form the dashed line. EnvEdge's waterline TAA only covers lake+solid pixels, so it never sees this open water.

Weight them by uHold*(1-smoothstep(4.0,14.0,dist)), starting at a total slope of 0.10. Tune to F420/F402 bottom-strip luma sd 16-18 at an unchanged mean (+-3 levels). 2) Break the train's regularity in lkWaveH: amplitude x(1 +- 0.25) and a +-0.25 m phase from a 2D value noise of (angle*6, r/6), so the crests never form a compass arc. 3) Filter the tilted lookups: where the crest tilt magnifies the target (target texels per screen px > 1), give lkRay's textureGrad a minimum footprint of ~1.5 target texels along J. Measure ?lkmscale=1,0.75 on T1 in the hold only, as a cost/quality A/B. 4) Dither the march: offset the LK_WAVE2 start height by (ign(gl_FragCoord.xy, uFrame)-0.5)*0.173/LK_WAVE2_N, which kills the coherent dashed row; re-check that the crest silhouettes stay continuous, as judge 2 required. 5) Fade the rest ring bands (ringSlope) closer than ~6 m from the camera during the pop and release, so no broad crescent crosses the bottom between the two models.

fix_tasks.title: Ice reads as frosted carved ice, not cloud-printed resin: gentle clarity variation stretched along the ring
fix_tasks.evidence_summary: q00 band right (x790-860 y352-410): luma sd 23.0 vs 11.4, p5 145 vs 176. Lower arcs (x600-840 y440-530): sd 18.4 vs 11.5. 3-12 px energy is 8.4-10.1 vs 4.0-5.2. q01 shows isotropic white cloud blobs and saturated blue patches where loop_F015 has even frost with a darker band along the inner edge; the p06 band has smeared white blobs; the jury's band_q00_2x reads camouflage. Large-scale structure is weaker than the reference (band left LF 11.4 vs 14.6, eye outer ring 22.4 vs 26.5).
fix_tasks.root_cause: IceMaterial r11 main sets rough = 0.233 + 0.767*frostLin, where frostLin is a steep linear map of Noise A (nA 0.5423 -> 0.7657 gives 0..1, plus the uFrost bias). Noise A is an isotropic fbm at ~0.5 m patches, so it acts as an almost binary clear/frosted mask. Roughness then switches several terms at once. frostK = smoothstep(0.35,1,rough)*uR11D.z (0.8) swaps the traced light Lt for Lf, a rough-1 lookup (copy mip 6.5 plus panorama). The orb lobe sig = 0.012 + uR11C.z*rough^2 makes frosted cones gather the orb's mean (white blobs). The entry Fresnel is cut toward 0.04. Clear patches therefore show the trace's crisp dark TIR zones (blue) and frosted patches a white diffuse mean, about 30 L apart, and isotropic. Note that lodFar already saturates at uR11E.y 7.5 for any roughness >= 0.233 (log2(1+4000*0.054) = 7.77), so through-shapes come from the panorama floor uR11E.w 0.45, not from the copy.
fix_tasks.implementation_plan: New uniform vec4 uR11P (x/y roughness ramp lo/hi, z frosted-diffuse share, w tangent stretch); ?icefrost=r11 = (0.233, 1.0, 0.8, 1) = today exactly. 1) Compress: rough = mix(0.45, 0.9, frostLin) and uR11D.z 0.8 -> 0.5 (start). Targets: q00 lower-arc sd ~12, band right sd 12-14 with p5 >= 170, mid-frequency energy ~5. 2) Stretch Noise A along the ring: sample it at ring-frame coordinates (s/4, rho - R, z) with s = R*atan(y,x). vObjPos is already the ring frame through uNoiseOffset, and R is uSectionRadius. Use a lattice periodic in theta (cells per revolution = round(2*pi*R/(4*cell))) so there is no seam at +-pi. Patches become long streaks along the ring. 3) uR11E.w 0.45 -> 0.6, so sky clouds never read as shapes through a band. 4) Check the large-scale structure still comes from the trace (band left LF >= 14, steel-blue far-wall bands on the oblique rings). 5) Gate against the panel's reference boxes and the Cycles twin (ICE_TARGETS Table 1). If the old twin renders are gone, re-render q00/q03/p06 from the twin scene in lane_backup/ice_untracked.tgz (minutes on Metal, through the slot).
